# Neon — calculated thermodynamic functions

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

Source: SRC-000518, NIST Chemistry WebBook / Chase (1998), retrieved 2026-10-08. These are calculations from dated fits, not new measurements. Values below are rounded to four decimal places for computational comparison; this is not a statement of physical precision. Uncertainty: UNKNOWN. Basis: **mol Ne**.

[Full calculation and limits](../0010-Neon-Ne-Thermochemistry.md) · [Complete 101-point-per-fit CSV](0010-Neon-Ne-TABLE-010-Thermodynamic-Functions.csv) · [Exact coefficients](../data/structured/0010-Neon-Ne-NIST-Thermochemistry.yaml)

| Fit | Variant | T / K | Cp° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | S° / J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ | H°(T)−H°(298.15 K) / kJ mol⁻¹ |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 298.0000 | 20.7860 | 146.3172 | -0.0031 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 3149.0000 | 20.7860 | 195.3254 | 59.2579 |
| GAS:01 | UNSPECIFIED-IN-FIT-TABLE | 6000.0000 | 20.7860 | 208.7257 | 118.5188 |

Each row uses only the named phase and fit interval. Do not subtract rows from different phases to obtain transition enthalpy without first resolving their standard-state reference offsets.

sources.scope: The retained species is neutral monatomic Ne GAS, CAS7440-01-9. The existing MAT:0010:ATOM:Ne /entity definition and unchanged parent /identity supply explicit identity only, not an observed sample, isotope, excited state or medium. Use mol Ne with one atom per source formula. No Ne2, ion, compound, plasma, condensed phase or equilibrium dissociation/ionisation mixture is inferred. Molecular spin-isomer scope is NOT-APPLICABLE-TO-MONATOMIC-SPECIES; fit isotope composition is UNSPECIFIED-IN-RETAINED-FIT. One GAS Shomate column covers298–6000K. Preserve all eight printed coefficients, including the four nonzero exponent-valued B–E terms, and all59 publisher rows. The raw first row is298K with a rounded negative-zero enthalpy, while the formula references298.15K. Retain the calculated printed-coefficient reference residual without forcing zero. No duplicate inter-fit endpoints, below298K/above6000K extrapolation, fluid EOS, liquid/solid behaviour, cryogenic phase boundary, latent heat or pressure-dependent function follows. Chase1998, March1982 source review, retained7October captures, fresh8October2026 exact retrievals and this software/source review are distinct provenance. The source one-bar entropy datum does not establish arbitrary applied sample pressure or fit error: pressure, coefficient uncertainty and covariance remain UNKNOWN. Printed rounding and residuals are computational checks, not physical uncertainty. Publisher tables and independent Python/JavaScript arithmetic evaluate the same compilation; no independent calorimetry or experimental replication is claimed. JANAF index SRC-000341, ASD, selected optical lines, He–Ne laser and Ne21 NMR works remain distinct. Retained copyright/reserved-rights text supplies no inferred open redistribution licence.
